Relax with the whole family at this peaceful place to stay. Just 5 min from the Airport and 15 min from the Blue Lagoon. Big garden along with beautiful trees all around that makes it so peaceful. Spacious kitchen and living room. 2 Cozy bathrooms and 4 bedrooms. Short distance to playgrounds, swimming pool, basketball courts, shops and nice restaurants. About 25 min drive from Reykjavik.
